title: Ordering a Meal and Fixing an Order
context: Nina 在餐厅坐下后向服务员 Ben 点烤鸡配米饭。服务员误上了鱼，核对后换成烤鸡；饭后 Nina 核对账单并付款。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Could I have the chicken, please? Is it grilled or fried?
dialogue.zh: 请给我鸡肉，好吗？是烤的还是炸的？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: It is grilled, and it comes with rice or potatoes.

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Rice, please. Does the chicken come with a sauce?
dialogue.zh: 请配米饭。鸡肉带酱汁吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes. The sauce comes on the side. I will put your order in.
dialogue.zh: 是的，酱汁另外放。我这就下单。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Excuse me, I ordered chicken, but this looks like fish. Could you check?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我点的是鸡肉，但这看起来像鱼。能帮我核对一下吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: You are right. I brought the wrong plate. I am sorry; I will get your chicken.
dialogue.zh: 你说得对，我拿错了餐盘。很抱歉，我去拿你的鸡肉。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Thank you. I will wait for the chicken and rice.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Here is your grilled chicken with rice and the sauce on the side.
dialogue.zh: 这是你的烤鸡配米饭，酱汁另外放。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: That is what I ordered. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: You are welcome. Here is your check whenever you are ready.
dialogue.zh: 不客气。你准备好付款时，这是账单。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: I have finished, thanks. The check shows one chicken meal, right? May I pay by card?
dialogue.zh: 我吃完了，谢谢。账单上是一份鸡肉餐，对吗？我可以刷卡吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes, one chicken meal. You can pay by card right here.
dialogue.zh: 对，一份鸡肉餐。你可以在这里刷卡。

expressions.zh: 请给我……？点餐时礼貌提出所需。
expressions.example: Could I have the grilled chicken, please?

expressions.zh: 配有、附带；用于询问餐点包含什么。
expressions.example: Does the meal come with rice?

expressions.zh: 另外放在旁边；常用于酱汁等配料。
expressions.example: Could I have the dressing on the side?

expressions.zh: 能帮我核对一下吗？用于委婉提出疑问。
expressions.example: This looks different from my order. Could you check?

expressions.zh: 账单；美式英语中在餐厅可用这个词。
expressions.example: Could we have the check, please?

pronunciation: grilled /ɡrɪld/ 结尾有 /ld/，不要加一个音节；check /tʃɛk/ 开头是 /tʃ/。练习 Could you check? 时将 could you 自然连读，保持 check 清楚。

practice.title: Part 1 · Eating out
practice.prompt: What do you usually order when you eat out?
practice.answer: I often order grilled chicken with rice. I like simple meals, and I usually ask for the sauce on the side.

practice.title: Part 2 · A meal away from home
practice.prompt: Describe a meal you had away from home. Say where you ate, what you ordered, and what made the meal memorable.
practice.answer: Last month I had lunch at a small restaurant near my office. I ordered grilled chicken with rice because I wanted a warm, simple meal. The server brought fish by mistake, so I politely explained what I had ordered. She checked and brought the chicken. It was tasty, and I thanked her for helping me. I would happily eat there again. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Restaurant service
practice.prompt: How can customers and restaurant staff solve a mistake calmly?
practice.answer: A customer can explain the problem clearly and give the staff a chance to check. Staff can listen, apologize, and explain what they can do next.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先逐句跟读，再扮演顾客：点主菜、询问做法，礼貌指出错菜并核对账单。
practice.answer: 用 4–6 句完成点餐和纠错；换一种主菜，再请同伴回应。
